method: The page declares the family `Phyre PPostProcessing module` (a classification family: ordinary functions grouped by module, not template copies). engine_explained did not credit these members. Another local Claude session (repos-91, session local-ee-drafter) drafted one sentence and 1-5 interior anchors per body from OPUS's pack (`mem_pack.py`, filtered against engine_explained's own set); OPUS checked every row mechanically with `interior_ingest.py` (member mode). A second local agent, not the drafter, then read every one of the 295 rows of this batch against the disassembly: 286 stood, 9 rows were corrected in 14 clauses (signed compares worded above/below, two missing pass-through arguments, one wrong value on a path, one overgeneralised compare direction, one 16-bit edge). OPUS confirmed corrections at the bytes on a sample; they are listed below. Neither agent is an independent reviewer: the non-author check is SWE2-AUDIT-SPEC's.
